api:
The contract docs/CAMPAIGN_API.md is updated in §1.11, §1.13, §1.16, §3.1 (steps 3 and 6), §3.3, §3.4, §4, §5.4 to §5.10, §8, §11.2 and §11.3, plus a new §11.5 with the before/after table.

Bases (OV.BaseSim):
- canSellCraft(G, craftId) returns null or a reason: 'noCraft', 'away' (not in its hangar, in a dogfight, or on the active mission) or 'crew' (soldiers aboard).
- sellCraft(G, craftId) returns {ok:true, price} or {ok:false, reason}. It adds Data.crafts[type].sell to funds. Fitted weapons, their loaded ammo (in whole items) and all cargo go to base.stores. The craft is removed from G.crafts and base.crafts, which frees its hangar and stops its rent.
- Data.crafts[type].sell is a new field: Skyranger 375000, Interceptor 450000, Firestorm 300000, Avenger 675000.
- cancelResearch(G, baseId, topic) now returns {ok:true, returned: unitType|null}. The live alien of an interrogation goes back to containment, even over capacity. A consumed item is still not returned (orig).
- canDismantle only checks capacities the facility itself provides. For hangars it also counts paid craft production orders, the same way freeHangars does.
- Rearm: craftRearmShort is pushed once per short ammo item, when no other weapon is still rearming.

Campaign (OV.Campaign):
- New baseVolley(G, baseId, ufoId) returns {shots, destroyed}. Base defences fire once and it sets ufo.siege = {baseId, shots}. Calling it again returns the same shots without firing.
- baseDefence(G, baseId, ufoId) returns {result, shots, soldiersLost} as before. It calls baseVolley first (no-op if the defences already fired), then resolves the garrison against the hull left.
- New event baseSpotted {baseId, missionId, etaS}, stop:true, in EVENTS.
- dogfightStart has a new optional field scramble:true.

New UFO field: ufo.siege is null or {baseId, shots}. It is set on assault runs at the base; spawnUfo initialises it to null.

Missions (OV.Missions):
- scan10m: when it finds a base it pushes baseSpotted and sets countdownS to at least TUNE.RETALIATION_WARNING_MIN × 60.
- spawnUfo: the assault Battleship is created detected (stats.ufosDetected++, ufoDetected).
- onSiteCleared: a terror site is removed after any result (win, loss or abort), with no terrorSiteExpired. UFO sites and alien bases are still cleared only on a win.

World (OV.World): when an assault UFO reaches its base, contacts runs the siege in this order:
1. baseAttack event.
2. baseVolley.
3. Scramble: ready, armed, non-transport crafts in that hangar take off into dogfights (at most MAX_DOGFIGHTS), and the World stops.
4. On the first tick with no dogfight left, baseDefence.

The speed rule does not apply to a craft engaging the assault ship of its own base (contact, contacts, and no tooSlow warning in canOrder). detect never loses an assault ship that is already detected.

Dogfight (OV.Dogfight): an assault-run UFO never breaks off. When its escape countdown reaches 0, the dogfight ends 'disengaged'.

Economy (OV.Economy.monthEnd): income includes countries whose pact was signed at this month end. The +150 pact points are subtracted from alienTotal before the rating and funding changes, but stay in score.all.alien.

Research data (OV.Data.researchEffects): when alien_origins or martian_solution completes, it grants leaderInterrogated or commanderInterrogated if a matching rank was interrogated earlier. This is read from the interrogate_<unit> topics in researched; there is no new state.

Save (OV.Save.fromJSON): new deep validation. It rejects malformed state with save.err.parse:
- t not a non-negative multiple of 5, or month not equal to monthIndex(t);
- non-integer funds; broken ids or score;
- malformed countries, bases, crafts, soldiers, UFOs, missions, sites or alien bases.

It repairs obvious defaults: missing transfers, aliens or spotted; counters, flags and seen; short or null weapons lists; missing loadouts; a non-object ui. Hand-written dogfights are dropped. It then runs every §3.1 clock handler once on a JSON clone; any exception becomes save.err.parse.

Tuning (OV.TUNE): BASE_DEFENCE_BASE 850, BASE_DEFENCE_PER_COEF 100, so the requirement is 850 / 1050 / 1250 by difficulty; BASE_DEFENCE_FACILITY_PCT stays 100. New RETALIATION_WARNING_MIN 1440.

Tools:
- campaign_bot keeps the squad home while its base is targeted, disengages hopeless scrambles, and reports `spotted`.
- sim.js campaign prints a per-seed "base localizada" list and a summary line "ataques à base N (ufoDestroyed, repelled, lost), bases localizadas, bases perdidas".
summary:
I fixed all 10 findings. Each one reproduced with its evidence script before the fix and shows the corrected behaviour after it. New tests are in tools/tests/geo_wave4fix.test.js (13 tests, about 0.2 s).

**The suite is not fully green: 585 pass, 2 fail.** Both failures are UI-completeness tests:
- base_ui_i18n needs the text `base.err.crew`;
- geoui_model needs a GeoUI reaction for `baseSpotted`.

The lead told me to add the event, and I can't edit js/ui or js/i18n, so the UI fixer has to close these two (details in open issues). The other runs pass: `node tools/sim.js battle --ufo all --seeds 3 --det` exits 0 (33 battles), the campaign sweep below exits 0, and a save-and-reload halfway through a campaign (`--save-mid 50`) exits 0.

**What was fixed**
1. **Interrogation trap:** questioning a leader or commander "too early" now still counts. When «Origens Alienígenas» or «A Solução Marciana» finishes, the flag is granted if that rank was questioned before. This is documented as an "ours" rule. With the alien-base surrender (1 commander + 2 leaders), questioning the commander first no longer locks Cydonia. Cancelling an interrogation now returns the alien to containment.
2. **Terror site after a lost or aborted battle:** the site is now removed after any battle, as in OpenXcom, so there is no extra −1000 when it expires. I updated the tests in campaign_flow and geo_missions that pinned the old rule.
3. **Retaliation:**
   - When the aliens find a base, a new stop event `baseSpotted` fires, and the assault is at least 24 h away (`RETALIATION_WARNING_MIN`).
   - The assault Battleship appears on radar as soon as it spawns and is never lost.
   - At the base, the defences fire first. Ready armed interceptors then scramble into dogfights, with no speed requirement because the ship comes to them. Only then does the garrison resolve the attack.
   - I resized the defence requirement to 850 + 100 per difficulty step (850 / 1050 / 1250). With the 8 starting soldiers at home, Veterano holds in 20/20 seeds and loses 1–3 soldiers. Super-humano needs a defence facility or better soldiers.
   - A player with the squad out still loses the base, but the warning, the attack and the result popups all come before the game over.
4. **Selling crafts:** new `BaseSim.sellCraft` and `canSellCraft`, plus a sell price per craft type. Only from the hangar and with no soldiers aboard; weapons and cargo go back to stores, and the rent and hangar are freed.
5. **Pact at month end:** the country that signs a pact still pays the month that ended. Its +150 points are kept out of that month's rating.
6. **Rearm spam:** a weapon with no ammo in stores is reported once per rearm cycle instead of every hour.
7. **Contract vs shipped values:** §5.9 and §8 now say defences count at 100 % (the shipped value). The dogfight approach change (2 → 4 per tick) is listed in §11.2.
8. **Dismantling a hangar:** a hangar reserved by a paid Firestorm or Avenger order can no longer be dismantled.
9. **Dismantling with full stores:** overfull stores no longer block dismantling an empty lab or workshop.
10. **Corrupt saves:** `Save.fromJSON` now checks the whole campaign state. It repairs obvious gaps and rejects the rest with `save.err.parse`. It then runs every clock step once on a copy, so a broken file is refused instead of crashing the Geoscape.

**Campaign bot**
- It keeps the squad at home while its base is targeted.
- It disengages scrambles it cannot win.
- I fixed one existing bot bug that the faster story exposed: if Cydonia was researched before the Avenger was built, power suits used up the alloys reserved for the Avenger, so it was never built.

**Before/after sweep** (`node tools/sim.js campaign --seeds 6 --diff 0,1 --days 240 --det`)

| | Recruta before | Recruta after | Veterano before | Veterano after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Victories | 5/6 | 5/6 | 2/6 | 1/6 |
| Council defeats | 0 | 0 | 2/6 | 1/6 |
| Base losses | 0 | 0 (4 attacks, all repelled) | 0 | 0 (10 attacks, all repelled) |
| Median victory day | 132 | 135.5 | 159.25 | 144.5 |
| Terror sites expired | 7 | 4 | 15 | 8 |

Six seeds are a small sample. The one Veterano victory lost is seed 2: it reached Cydonia and lost that battle (the bot has no Blaster Launchers). Seed 5 now survives to day 240 instead of losing to the council on day 119. Raw outputs are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/simfix/before_sweep.txt, /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/simfix/after2_sweep.txt and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/simfix/battle_det.txt.
deviations: sellCraft follows the lead's rule and refuses while soldiers are aboard (reason 'crew'). It does not refuse because of cargo: loose cargo and fitted weapons with their ammo go back to stores automatically, as OpenXcom does. Requiring the player to unload item by item first would be poor UX.

The scramble at the base is automatic: ready, armed, non-transport crafts take off. Each dogfight opens in standoff, out of the Battleship's range, so the player decides whether to attack or disengage. I measured that the starting Interceptors almost never hurt a Battleship (0–400 of 3000 hull, usually both lost in 'standard' mode). The Veterano requirement was therefore sized so the garrison alone holds, and the scramble pays off with later crafts.

Also an 'ours' rule: the assault Battleship spawns already detected (ufoDetected) and is never lost by radar, because the base was warned by baseSpotted. This replaces the reviewer's alternative of spawning it 45 degrees or more away.
When an assault-run dogfight's escape countdown ends, the dogfight ends 'disengaged' (the ship flies past to the base), so it can never stall in standoff.

I changed tests owned by others because they pinned the old rules or had unrealistic fixtures: geo_base (interrogation order), campaign_flow (terror loss), geo_missions (terror abort), geo_economy (pact income), campaign_pacing (base defence constants 850/100/100), save_roundtrip (G.t was set without G.month).
I did not edit DESIGN.md, which is not in my file list. The dogfight approach change (2 to 4) is documented only in CAMPAIGN_API §11.2.
open_issues: UI fixer (makes the strict suite green again): add 'base.err.crew' to js/i18n/pt-PT.base.js, for example «Há soldados a bordo — tire-os da nave primeiro.». Without it, base_ui_i18n.test.js fails.

UI fixer (makes the strict suite green again): GeoUI must react to the new stop event baseSpotted {baseId, missionId, etaS}. Add it to GeoUI.model.REACT as a popup with terror tone and the siren, plus the i18n key geo.ev.baseSpotted (title and body). Example: «Os alienígenas localizaram a base {base} — ataque iminente (não antes de {eta})», where eta is formatted from etaS seconds and is at least 24 h. Advice line: trazer a equipa para casa, manter soldados e intercetores na base, construir defesas. Buttons «Ir para a base» (BaseUI.open) and OK. Without it, geoui_model.test.js fails.

UI (BaseUI, Naves tab and/or market sell list): add a «Vender nave» button that confirms and shows the price (Data.crafts[type].sell). Disable it with T('base.err.' + BaseSim.canSellCraft(G, craftId)). It calls BaseSim.sellCraft(G, craftId), which returns {ok, price}. Refresh the hangars and monthly upkeep afterwards, and tell the player that weapons and cargo went to stores.

UI (GeoUI/DogfightUI, base attack): baseAttack now means the defences have already fired and the base's ready armed crafts are taking off. Dogfights for those crafts arrive as dogfightStart with scramble:true; DogfightUI should label them «Defesa da base» and hint that disengaging is wise against a Battleship. When the escape timer runs out, an assault-run dogfight ends 'disengaged': for UFOs with targetBaseId, the df.end text could read «O Couraçado passou e segue para a base». The baseDefence popup then reports the ground result (shots = the single defence volley).

UI (GeoUI ufoDetected popup): if ufo.targetBaseId is set, say «Couraçado a caminho da base» and offer «Interceptar» with no too-slow warning (canOrder no longer returns tooSlow for crafts of the target base).

UI text (pt-PT.base.js): 'base.research.hint.leader' and 'base.research.hint.commander' still say «Só … interrogado depois de …». With the retroactive rule, an earlier leader or commander interrogation also counts when Origens or Solução Marciana completes. Suggested: «Um líder ou comandante interrogado revela o plano dos invasores (mesmo que o interrogatório tenha sido antes de «Origens Alienígenas»).» Also, the cancel-interrogation dialog can say the alien returns to containment (cancelResearch returns {returned}).
UI (CampaignUI load/import): corrupt or edited saves now throw save.err.parse at load time instead of crashing the Geoscape later. Check that the import dialog shows T('save.err.parse').
Docs owner: DESIGN §22 needs the dogfight approach entry (2 to 4 per tick, ours, shorter duels). It is already in CAMPAIGN_API §11.2.

Pacing, not addressed here: Veterano victories in the bot remain low (1/6 to 2/6). The limiting factors are bot battle play (Cydonia lost without Blaster Launchers; slow retries after a failed alien-base assault, e.g. Recruta seed 3 waits 100+ days for a live commander). Battle counts are still 17 to 18.5 versus the 12–16 target.
